newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sega falls on report of lower shipments.
newsitem.headline: Sega falls on report of lower shipments.

text.p: Shares of Sega Enterprises Ltd fell in Wednesday afternoon trade, depressed by media reports that the video game maker was planning to cut shipments of its Sega Saturn game machine in the next business year, brokers said.
As of 0414 GMT, the shares had fallen 140 yen to 3,160.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun newspaper said Sega plans to ship three to four million units of its Sega Saturn video game machine in the next business year, down from expected total shipments of 4.35 million in the year to March 31.
It said the move represented a retreat by Sega in the battle for the home-use video game market.
A Sega spokeswoman declined to comment on the report, and said the company had yet to decide on its business plan for game machines for the next business year.
